text: At 31 December 2025 the French State held 15.01% of Renault's share capital, corresponding to 21.92% of theoretical voting rights.
short: The French State holds 15.01% of Renault.

source.name: Renault Group: 2025 Universal Registration Document
source.quote: the French State held 15.01% of the share capital, corresponding to 21.92% of theoretical voting rights and 22.24% of exercisable voting rights in Renault

additionalSources.name: Agence des participations de l'État, Rapport relatif à l'État actionnaire (annex to the 2026 budget bill), Renault page
additionalSources.quote: L’État détient 15,01 % du capital, correspondant à 22,14 % des droits de vote de Renault.
